title: Lanework comment
description: A comment's `index.md` under a card's `comments/`. No `title` and no `order`: the thread sorts by `created`.

kind.description: `comment`. Written at creation; the only discriminator inside `comments/.trash/`.

created.description: When the comment was posted, and by whom. Load-bearing: the thread sorts by this, ascending.

modified.description: The last write to the comment's content. Differing from `created` is the whole of the edited indicator.

reactions.description: The comment's emoji reactions. A comments feature firmly: no other level carries this key.

in-reply-to.description: The uuid of a sibling comment. Identity-shaped or no reading at all; a value naming no sibling is legal and renders a quiet hint.

modified-by.description: Retired: folds into `modified.by`. The map wins where both are present.

author.description: Retired: the comment's original attribution key, folded into `created.by` as `{name: …}` by a scheduled heal.

deleted.description: Retired: the tombstone model. A deleted comment moves into `comments/.trash/`.
